title: Exploit Chain: Banned User Authentication Bypass → RBAC Bypass → Credential Theft
description: Step 1: Banned/INACTIVE user can still authenticate because vulnerableAuth middleware does not check user.status (finding-031, CWE-306). Step 2: Authenticated banned user exploits broken RBAC middleware (finding-020, CWE-285) which allows CUSTOMER role to access ADMIN-only endpoints. Step 3: Attacker accesses GET /api/v1/users and GET /api/v1/users/:id endpoints (finding-025,027, CWE-200) which expose password hashes of ALL users in the system.
impact: Banned users retain full system access and can escalate to admin-level data access, exfiltrating all user password hashes for offline cracking.
mitigation: 1) Add user.status === ACTIVE check in authentication middleware. 2) Fix vulnerableRequireRole middleware logic. 3) Remove password_hash from API responses. 4) Implement account status validation in login/refresh commands.

history.details: Constructed by chaining findings finding-031, finding-020, finding-025, finding-027.
